samples.summary: `useDateFormat` / `subscribe` are entirely untested; the same-tab and cross-tab re-render behavior the module exists for is never exercised
samples.evidence: The new test file only exercises the pure `getDateFormat`/`setDateFormat` pair. The hook (`useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getDateFormat, () => DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT)`, date-format-preference.ts:55-59) and its `subscribe` (lines 42-49, incl. the `storage` listener and unsubscribe cleanup) have no test at all — so a broken subscribe (e.g. wrong event name, listener never removed, snapshot not re-read) would not fail any test even though the module's whole purpose per its own doc comment is keeping Settings and the documents list in sync. `@testing-library/react`'s `renderHook` is already used in this repo (packages/frontend/tests/components/notifications/use-mark-read.test.tsx:2), so a hook test was available.

samples.summary: "notifies subscribers in the same tab" test bypasses the production subscription path and asserts only a hardcoded event-name string
samples.evidence: The test attaches its own listener for the literal string "wafflebase-date-format-change" rather than going through `subscribe`/`useDateFormat`. It therefore verifies only that `setDateFormat` dispatches an event with that exact name — a restatement of the implementation — and would still pass if `subscribe` listened for a different event, ignored `storage`, or the hook never re-read the snapshot. It is coverage of a private constant, not of the notification behavior.

samples.summary: New `DateCell` component (preference-driven text + always-present full date/time tooltip) has no test
samples.evidence: `DateCell` is the user-visible behavior change: it reads `useDateFormat()` and sets `title={formatFullDateTime(value)}`. No test renders it — Grep for "date-format"/DateCell across packages/frontend returned only the utils/preference modules and their unit tests. So the wiring (cell shows the exact date when the preference is "exact", tooltip always present, em dash for bad values in the DOM) is unverified even though sibling files do render components with @testing-library (e.g. tests/app/docs/docs-context-menu.test.tsx).

finding.summary: `useDateFormat` / `subscribe` are entirely untested; the same-tab and cross-tab re-render behavior the module exists for is never exercised
finding.evidence: The new test file only exercises the pure `getDateFormat`/`setDateFormat` pair. The hook (`useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getDateFormat, () => DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT)`, date-format-preference.ts:55-59) and its `subscribe` (lines 42-49, incl. the `storage` listener and unsubscribe cleanup) have no test at all — so a broken subscribe (e.g. wrong event name, listener never removed, snapshot not re-read) would not fail any test even though the module's whole purpose per its own doc comment is keeping Settings and the documents list in sync. `@testing-library/react`'s `renderHook` is already used in this repo (packages/frontend/tests/components/notifications/use-mark-read.test.tsx:2), so a hook test was available.
searchedFor: grep renderHook usage in frontend tests

verdict.reason: The finding's stated evidence is factually wrong and the residual gap is below this lens's blocking bar. The test file is not limited to "the pure getDateFormat/setDateFormat pair": tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts:31-40 ("notifies subscribers in the same tab") attaches a real window listener to the literal "wafflebase-date-format-change" event, calls setDateFormat("exact"), and asserts exactly one notification — that is the same-tab sync wire subscribe registers on (date-format-preference.ts:43 uses the same CHANGE_EVENT constant), so a missing dispatch or renamed event does fail a test. The other three tests (14-17 default, 19-24 round-trip, 26-29 junk fallback) are non-vacuous and would fail if the storage read/write logic broke; nothing under test is mocked away. I confirmed by wide search that no test renders the hook: case-insensitive grep for date-format|dateFormat repo-wide returns no other test file, no test imports @/app/documents/document-list or @/app/settings/page, the only three renderHook users (tests/components/notifications/use-mark-read.test.tsx, tests/app/slides/use-slide-background.test.ts, src/hooks/use-view-analytics.test.ts) are unrelated, and there is no e2e suite. So the truly uncovered surface is the five-line useSyncExternalStore wrapper (lines 55-59), the "storage" listener (line 44) and the unsubscribe cleanup (45-48). Under this lens's rubric that is "coverage could be broader but the core behavior is tested" (minor), not "a clear behavior change with no meaningful test at all" (major); the rubric explicitly says not to flag add-more-tests as a blocker in that situation.
